description_en: Queries the details of a memory
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-memory-detail --tenant-id 10001 --owner-type group --group-id cg_12345 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMemoryDetail

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The owner type. A value of user indicates the personal memory of the authenticated user. A value of group indicates the memory of a specified workspace
parameters.help_zh: user 为鉴权用户的个人记忆；group 为指定协作空间记忆
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to group
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID；ownerType 为 group 时必填
parameters.name: group_id

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

groups.description_en: The list of groups for automatically collected memories. If no automatic memories exist, an empty array is returned
groups.description_zh: 自动拾取记忆的分组列表；无自动记忆时为空数组
groups.example: [{"type":"user","items":[{"id":"user/example.md","title":"示例偏好","content":"喜欢简洁的回答","description":"来自近期会话的偏好总结"}],"gmtModified":1720000000}]

items.description_en: The list of groups for automatically collected memories. If no automatic memories exist, an empty array is returned
items.description_zh: 自动拾取记忆的分组列表；无自动记忆时为空数组

gmtModified.description_en: The last modification time of the group. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If no files exist, null is returned
gmtModified.description_zh: 该分组最近修改时间，Unix 秒级时间戳；无文件时为 null

items.description_en: The list of automatic memory entries under this type. If no entries exist, an empty array is returned
items.description_zh: 该类型下的自动记忆条目列表；没有条目时为空数组
items.example: [{"id":"user/example.md","title":"示例偏好","content":"喜欢简洁的回答","description":"来自近期会话的偏好总结"}]

items.description_en: The list of automatic memory entries under this type. If no entries exist, an empty array is returned
items.description_zh: 该类型下的自动记忆条目列表；没有条目时为空数组

content.description_en: The body of the automatic memory, excluding the YAML frontmatter
content.description_zh: 自动记忆正文，不包含 YAML frontmatter

description.description_en: The additional description of the automatic memory. If no description is available, an empty string is returned
description.description_zh: 自动记忆的附加描述；没有时为空字符串
description.example: 来自近期会话的偏好总结

id.description_en: The unique identifier of the automatic memory entry, which is a relative OSS path
id.description_zh: 自动记忆条目的唯一标识，为相对 OSS 路径

title.description_en: The title of the automatic memory, which is derived from the file metadata or file name
title.description_zh: 自动记忆标题，来自文件元数据或文件名

type.description_en: The type of the automatic memory. Valid values: user, feedback, reference, and project
type.description_zh: 自动记忆类型：user、feedback、reference 或 project

message.example: 当前用户不是群组 cg_12345 的活跃成员

profile.description_en: The manually added memory from profile.md. It includes the full content, existence status, and modification time
profile.description_zh: 手动添加的记忆，来自 profile.md；包含完整内容、存在状态和修改时间

content.description_en: The full body of the manual memory. If the memory has never been saved, an empty string is returned
content.description_zh: 手动记忆的完整正文；未保存过时为空字符串

exists.description_en: Indicates whether profile.md exists. If the memory has never been saved, false is returned
exists.description_zh: profile.md 是否存在；未保存过时为 false

gmtModified.description_en: The last modification time of profile.md. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If the file does not exist or its metadata cannot be obtained, null is returned
gmtModified.description_zh: profile.md 最近修改时间，Unix 秒级时间戳；文件不存在或无法取得元数据时为 null
